@user **Proposed fix for INC-001** · option A: Keep these stations out of dispatch until they report a real timestamp
Why: A 1970 timestamp means we cannot tell how old the counts are. Excluding is reversible: a station is re-admitted the first minute it reports a valid time.
What changes if approved:
- 47 stations stay out of the dispatch view (22 of them in Manhattan below 96 St).
- Re-admitted automatically the first minute they pass the contract again. Nothing is deleted.
Alternative B: Admit the counts and treat them as reported now.
Sign-off needed. Reply `@fixer approve INC-001` (or `@fixer approve INC-001 B`), or `@fixer reject INC-001`.

@user **Proposed fix for INC-004** · option A: Answer from the last good data, stating its age, for up to 30 minutes

What changes if approved:
- The analyst answers from data last updated 1 min ago, says so in every answer, and refuses after 30 min.
Alternative B: Pause dispatch answers until the feed recovers.
